# Peripherals and SoC Integration

## Concepts

Address maps, timers, serial interfaces, GPIO, reset, and clock distribution.

## Implementation

Integrate representative peripherals with a processor and document the SoC address map.

## Hands-on Experiments

Boot a minimal program that accesses peripherals and validates interrupt-driven operation.

For each experiment, record the tool versions, design configuration, commands, inputs, expected results, and observed results.
